claim: Fee schedule: masonry/metal/concrete up to 1.80m PHP3 per linear meter; over 1.80m PHP4 per linear meter. Both source rows print "of fraction thereof". Indigenous materials, barbed, chicken or hog wire: PHP2.40 per linear meter. The service introduction says a fence not exceeding 1.80m, while the fee table includes over-1.80m; preserve both rather than infer an eligibility rule.
